name: Brenna Coldwater
acBreakdown: Scale mail +4, Dex +1, wooden shield +1, Shield Expert +1

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.notes: Advantage on your first attack with it each round. Two-handed (no shield): 1d10+4.

personality: Six winters on the Boldock Wall taught you that the dark beyond the firelight is full of things that want in. You took the Keepers' coin to see the world past the Red Waste. You have never shared a fire with an orc and you are not sure you can start now.
hook: There is an orc chieftain in the common room, and the house rules say no fighting.
abilitiesHtml:
Weapon Specialisation (longsword). Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and +1 damage (already in the line above).

Combat Manoeuvres. You can use every manoeuvre in the Codex (Trip, Disarm, Shove, Shield Blow, Guard and the rest). Your own: Intimidating Strike, on a hit the target makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Manoeuvre Mastery. Manoeuvres that would give your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow) are rolled normally.

Battle Space. You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only from opposite sides.

Combat Reflexes (free feat). Once per round, an Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Shield Expert (feat, 1st). +1 AC with a shield (included), and your shield bonus adds to Reflex saves (included).

Mighty Deed of Arms (feat, 3rd). Once per round, call your shot and roll a d4 with the attack. On a hit and a 3 or 4: knock Prone, disarm, push 10ft, blind until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack. Save DC 14 (Fortitude for prone, push or disarm; Reflex for blind; Will for the penalty). A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

Kit: Boldock Wall Guard. Waste-Hardened: creatures with the Orc ancestry tag have Disadvantage on their first attack roll against you each round, and can't make you Frightened. Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks on watch or guard duty.

Human. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill). You picked up Orcish on the Wall, listening to raiders across the ditch.

name: Hulda Frostbraid

weapons.name: Light crossbow
weapons.notes: 80ft. Armour Piercing. One shot a round.

spells.notes: Other good picks tonight: Shield of Faith, Protection from Alignment, Detect Secret Doors (1st); Silence, Hold Person, Lesser Restoration (2nd).

personality: Ilmater is the god of those who suffer through the long winter, and you go where the suffering is. The Keepers pay a field priest's wage. You have set bones in blizzards before and you are quietly proud of it.
hook: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Perfect Recall. Once a day, recall a 1st-level spell you've already cast with a Wisdom check (DC 10) and cast it again without spending a slot.

Steadfast Faith (2nd). Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead: drains, paralysis, fear and possession.

Ilmater's Favour. Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once a day: heal a creature 2d8+3 HP. Favoured weapon: cestus.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Dwarf. Advantage on saves against poison, and Resistance 5 to poison damage. Speed never reduced by armour or encumbrance. Advantage on stonework checks. Stonebraced: once a day, treat a critical hit against you as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown. Advantage on Brewing checks (chosen craft). Clan weapon: your grandmother's war hammer.

name: Pip Thistlewick
acBreakdown: Leather armour +2, Dex +3. Leather is Insulated: Resistance 5 to cold

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.notes: 50ft. Stones are free: pick them up as you go (a pouch of 20 would take a slot).

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.notes: Throwing knives, 20ft. Finesse, Light, Concealable, Thrown. Knives bundle 5 a slot, so both take 1.

personality: The Keepers think you are a scout. The Veiled Ones think you are their eyes on the frontier. Both are paying you, and you would like to keep it that way. You notice things, write them down, and pass them on.
hook: The innkeeper keeps a locked door behind the bar, and he checks it every hour.
abilitiesHtml:
Sneak Attack. Once a round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft (it can't see you, hasn't acted yet this fight, is in melee with an ally and not you, or you're flanking it): Advantage on the attack and +2d6 damage (1d6 Rogue, +1d6 Predator). Cannot combine with Back Attack.

Back Attack. Once a round, after a successful Hide or Move Silently check, attacking from behind with a melee weapon shorter than your arm: Advantage and the weapon's dice are doubled (short sword 2d6+4).

Thief Skills. Trained in Lockpicking (one try per lock per level; Advantage with your lockpicks), Traps, Pick Pocket (DC 10 + target's Level) and Climb (rolled with Dex); Master in all four from 5th. Decipher Script (Int). Thieves' Cant.

Hide and Move Silently. Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above it, and not while running or charging. While lightly obscured, a Hide result of 12 to 14 still counts as Hidden. Listening through a solid barrier is at Disadvantage.

Hide and Move Silently together (3rd). Disadvantage on both, at quarter speed.

Detect Secret/Concealed Doors (3rd). Advantage on checks to find secret or concealed doors, and a free check whenever you pass within 10ft of one.

Precise Strikes. +1 damage on every weapon hit (included).

Hit and Run. On a turn you attack, your speed is 10ft higher. Once a round you can move through one enemy's space, and that doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

Cunning Step. Once a round, move away from a creature in your reach without provoking.

Alertness (feat, 1st). You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 initiative (included).

Predator (feat, 2nd). Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

Kit: The Veiled Ones. Silent Tail: Advantage to observe or tail someone unseen; a creature you watched for 10 minutes before a fight has Disadvantage on its attacks against you in the first round. Discreet Channels: Advantage on checks to gather, verify or pass on information quietly, or to explain why you're somewhere you shouldn't be.

Halfling. Lucky: on a natural 1 on an attack, check or save, reroll and take the new result, 3 times a session. Brave Heart: Advantage on saves against fear. Move through the space of any larger creature. Advantage on farming, foraging and plant identification.

name: Ithrien Vael

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

weapons.name: dagger
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

spells.notes: Also in your spellbook: Sleep, Grease, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages (1st).

personality: The Silver Tower sent you to Veradyna to catalogue the old magic of the frontier, and the Keepers were the only escort going north. You find the cold, the food and the company equally trying. You are very good, and you know it.
hook: Somewhere in this fort there is magic you can feel but not see.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Intelligence. Spell save DC 14, 15 for Conjuration (School Focus). Slots: 5 cantrips, four 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells from your spellbook each morning. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield. See the spell page.

Arcane Recovery. Once a day, after 10 minutes of study, regain spent slots totalling up to 2 spell levels.

Flexible Preparation. When you prepare spells, leave one place open for each spell level; fill it with any spell of that level from your spellbook when you cast it.

Potent Cantrips. A creature that saves against your damaging cantrip (Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost) still takes half damage.

School Focus: Conjuration. +1 to the save DC of your Conjuration spells (Grease, Web, Glitterdust).

Steady Focus (feat, 1st). Advantage on saves to keep a spell you are casting, or concentration, when damaged, shoved or forced to react. And you can't lose a spell to damage of 5 or less.

Kit: Silver Tower Scholar. Elemental Precision: reroll any 1s on the damage dice of your spells that deal elemental damage (once per die). Aldorethi Theory: Advantage recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.

High Elf. Immune to magical sleep, and Advantage on saves against charm. Trance (4 hours rests you). Keen Senses: Advantage on sight and hearing Perception, and on concentration saves. Arcane Sense: you feel significant magical auras within 60ft and their rough direction, no check. Extra cantrip (Read Magic). Weapon training: longsword, shortsword, longbow, rapier.

name: Ulrik Greyfang

weapons.name: Two-handed axe
weapons.notes: Two-handed, Heavy. Raging: 1d12+4. Power Attack works with it.

personality: A broad, grey-green half-orc with a shaved head and a wolf's-tooth necklace, raised by human trappers after a raid took his mother's people. Quiet until he isn't. He signed with the Keepers because they pay on time and nobody asks where he was born, and he likes Brenna more than she likes him.
inAFight: Rage on your first swing. Power Attack big targets with your first attack each round (Reckless gives nothing to a Power Attack, so pick Brutal and knock foes down for the others instead). Whirlwind when two weaklings crowd you, and throw a hand axe at anything that runs.
hook: The orc chieftain in the common room knows your clan's markings, and he hasn't stopped staring.
abilitiesHtml:
Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage (two-handed axe 1d12+4). It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Rage Styles (2nd). Each time you rage, pick one for that rage. Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 14). Terrifying: once per rage, Intimidate as part of an attack instead of with your action.

Whirlwind Attack (3rd). Once per rage, while raging, in place of your action: one attack roll against each of up to 2 foes within 5ft whose Level is 1 or lower. Not after retreating.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of your Level or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. No daily limit.

Combat Sense. Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being unseen, and Back Attack and the like don't work on you.

Primeval Instincts. Works in your scale mail (War Barbarian). Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances; you hold your breath twice as long and survive extreme cold and weather a day longer; Advantage on Fortitude saves to force march; you find shelter, food and water for yourself in the wild, light a fire in 1d10 minutes, always know north, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Thick Hide. +2 AC with no armour or light armour, so not in your scale mail.

Kit: War Barbarian. Armoured Fury: trained in heavy armour, and Primeval Instincts works in medium armour. Iron Rage: while you rage in medium or heavy armour, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.

Power Attack (feat, 1st). With the two-handed axe, your first attack each round can be a Power Attack: Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels, but a hit deals one extra d12. Never on an attack that already has Disadvantage.

Cleave (feat, 2nd). Cleave up to three times a turn with your two-handed axe (Cleaving), twice with anything else.

Half-Orc. Darkvision 60ft. Relentless Endurance: once a day, when damage would drop you to 0 HP or below, drop to 1 instead. Brutal Strikes: on a critical hit, roll one extra weapon die. Onslaught: spend 1 Luck to make one more weapon attack, in the same action, against a creature you've just damaged. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill).

name: Edda Rimewater

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Versatile: 1d8 in two hands. Ash wood, her focus.

spells.notes: Other good picks tonight: Thunderwave, Alarm (1st); Speak with Animals, Hold Animal, Warp Wood (2nd).

personality: A weather-lined woman from the far north, hair in bone-pinned braids, who talks to the wind as if it owes her money. She sees the spirits of a place the way others see furniture, and she is rarely surprised by either. The Keepers hired her to read the weather; she stayed because they kept walking into places the spirits warned her about.
inAFight: Entangle a pack before it reaches the line, Faerie Fire anything that hides, and keep Hulda's patients standing with Cure Light Wounds. Barkskin the front-liner before a big fight; when cornered, Wild Shape into something with teeth.
hook: The spirits around this inn are frightened of something inside it, and they won't say what.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Druid list. No metal armour or shield. See the spell page.

Wild Shape. Twice a day, as your action, become a beast (or one of the listed beast-like monsters) of Level 1 or lower for up to an hour, using its whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure. You keep your mind; you can't cast in a form that can't speak, and when the form drops to 0 HP you return with the HP you had.

Resist Elements (2nd). Advantage on saves against fire, water, earth, air, cold and lightning attacks.

Woodland Stride (3rd). Move through natural difficult terrain (thorns, briars, deep snow-choked undergrowth) at full speed, leaving no trail. Magical terrain still hinders you.

Nature Lore (Wisdom). In the far north, identify plants and animals perfectly, tell whether water is safe, and find shelter and food for one person; elsewhere it takes a Wisdom check. Feeding more takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds 2d4 more.

Kit: Shaman. Spirit Sight: Advantage on checks to perceive, talk to or identify spirits, ancestors and natural beings from beyond. During a long rest, ask the spirits one yes or no question about the area or a creature nearby; the answer comes as an impression, not words. Ancestor's Fury: in Wild Shape, your first hit each round deals an extra 1d4 damage of a type you choose.

Iron Constitution (Human bonus feat). Advantage on saves against poison and disease, and +1 Constitution (included).

Potent Casting (feat, 1st). Your spells ignore damage resistance (not immunity).

Human. Advantage on Survival checks (chosen skill). You speak Druidic, the circle's secret tongue, and Giant, from the northern traders.
